jobs.title: New Business Manager
jobs.description: Our company Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search - across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form. Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs. Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries. We’re a remote-first company , but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕). About the role We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process." On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side: working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn. You will be responsible for: Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting. Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies. Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency or at a company selling into agencies. Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting. Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs). No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing. Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that. Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools (we use HubSpot). Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above). Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience. What we offer: We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics: a monthly base of approximately $2,800–$3,500 USD paid via a B2B contract - the standard self-employed/contractor setup for our EU-based team - plus a bonus system. We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours. Location and Remote Work: We’re a remote-first company , but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation. Embracing Future-Facing Technology Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge! You will be expected to understand the client problem, ask sharper questions, spot weak scope, maintain account context, prepare for the right conversations, and make sure Storm is solving the right thing in the right order. AI is not an optional productivity trick in this role. You should be actively trying to become excellent at using AI tools, reusable workflows, and account-context systems to prepare better, move faster, remember more, and give clients a sharper experience. This is also a relationship role in the real sense. Clients should like working with you. They should feel you understand them, enjoy the conversation, trust your follow-up, and want you involved when things are unclear. If you are looking for a relationship-only account role where someone else owns the operational detail, this is not it. If you are looking for a pure project management or builder role with limited client responsibility, this is not it either. RESPONSIBILITIES What can you expect? Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory. Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points. Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory. jobs.title: Expert Short-Form Video Editor
jobs.description: About Exchange Life Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. We run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world. We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals — not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Core Responsibilities Edit TikTok and Reels content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time — not just aesthetics Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes Collaborate with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on winning formats Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day — no check-ins required Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant Must-Haves You can watch a viral video or winning ad and break down exactly what made it work A strong recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the last few months) Familiarity with multiple formats: headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, AI videos Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and know what to change next Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently Nice-to-Haves Experience editing for e-commerce brands Experience reading ad metrics and understanding what drives ad performance Not a Fit If Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content You can't point to a recent viral video or winning ad and explain why it performed You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive You're looking for a short-term project or side gig Compensation & Working Style Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD Compensation: Competitive base rate + uncapped monthly performance bonuses Location: 100% remote Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role Schedule: Fully flexible — work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required. Time off: Flexible PTO — take the time you need, just coordinate with the team Tools you'll use: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok/Meta analytics Growth: We invest in committed people — access to courses, software, and 1-on-1 mentorship Working style: No micromanagement

jobs.title: AI Operations Manager
jobs.description: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 25,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract 🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt! 🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits ✨ Exciting high growth product, relied on by leading global brands, particularly within sports 💻 Working with the latest hardware, AI tools, and product workflows. About the Role We are hiring an AI Operations Manager to help drive the operational quality, reliability, and effectiveness of Storyteller’s AI tooling. This role sits within our AI Operations function and is focused on making sure the AI tools, platforms, workflows, and configurations used across the business are well-run, dependable, and continuously improving. AI is moving quickly, and Storyteller is moving with it. We need someone who can stay close to what is changing in the AI tooling landscape, understand what matters for our business, and help turn that understanding into practical operational improvements. A big part of this role is making sure AI tooling is configured properly, used effectively, and operating reliably. You will work with teams who use AI tools day to day, understand where tooling is creating friction, identify what needs to change, and follow through on the detailed operational work that makes systems dependable. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants real responsibility for how AI tooling operates inside a fast-moving SaaS business. You will bring structure to messy tooling environments, improve visibility, support better standards, and help keep Storyteller in control of fast-changing AI platforms rather than reacting too late. This is not a passive maintenance role. It is for someone who likes improving systems, raising standards, and making AI tooling genuinely work better. About Storyteller Storyteller is a SaaS platform used by globally recognised brands across sport, media, entertainment, and beyond. Our platform helps companies create and deliver engaging story-style content experiences across their digital products. We work with high-profile clients, fast-moving teams, and products that are used by large audiences around the world. We are remote-first, product-led, and highly focused on execution. We care about clear communication, strong ownership, thoughtful use of technology, and building better ways of working as we grow. AI is already an important part of how our teams operate. The AI Operations function exists to make sure our AI tooling is reliable, well-configured, secure, useful, and continuously improving. This role is central to that work. What You Will Do Take operational ownership of the configuration, reliability, and standards of Storyteller’s AI tools and AI platforms. Support the AI Operations team’s response when AI tools, platforms, models, or underlying capabilities change. Set, maintain, and improve operational standards for how AI tooling is configured, accessed, used, and monitored. Improve visibility around AI tool configuration, platform usage, access administration, permissions, dependencies, and operational performance. Identify weak, unstable, or high-friction areas in our AI tooling setup and help develop practical solutions that are durable and scalable. Work with internal teams to understand where AI tooling is helping, where it is creating friction, and what needs to improve. Give leadership clearer visibility on where the AI tooling stack is performing well, where it is fragile, and what platform or workflow changes are needed next. Help ensure Storyteller’s AI tooling remains useful, controlled, reliable, and aligned with how the business actually works. What We Are Looking For Demonstrable experience managing or improving technical platforms, ideally including AI tools, automation platforms, LLM-based tools, or AI-enabled workflows. High agency and strong ownership of operational outcomes. Strong technical judgment, especially around AI tools, platform configuration, workflows, permissions, integrations, APIs, and dependencies.

jobs.title: Floating Medical Office Customer Service (LATAM only)
jobs.description: This is a remote position. Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English) ​ The Floating Medical Office Customer Service position provides temporary administrative coverage to different medical practices when staffing gaps occur due to vacations, sick leave, resignations, increased workload, or other unexpected absences. Unlike an assistant dedicated to a single client, the floating assistant must be able to quickly adapt to different providers, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols while maintaining service quality and minimizing disruption to the client. The position follows a rapid deployment model, meaning the floating assistant is not permanently assigned to a fixed group of clients. Instead, onboarding is provided when coverage is required for a specific medical practice. Responsibilities Responsibilities will depend on the workflows and operational requirements of each assigned medical practice and may include: Following appointment scheduling rules and provider preferences. Supporting insurance workflows. Assisting with referral processes. Supporting prior authorization procedures. Following patient communication protocols and telephone scripts. Following established escalation procedures. Maintaining internal documentation standards. Navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems. Reviewing and following client-specific documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Following daily operational processes and checklists. Adapting to different medical practices, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols. Requirements Must have your own device and headset High-speed internet connection of at least 100 MB. Previous experience working with U.S.-based medical offices and knowledge of HIPAA regulations. Ability to quickly adapt to different medical practices, providers, workflows, and operational protocols. Ability to continuously learn and transition between different client environments. Ability to learn and navigate different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and software platforms. Ability to understand and follow practice-specific scheduling rules, insurance workflows, referral processes, prior authorization procedures, and patient communication protocols. Ability to follow telephone scripts, escalation procedures, and internal documentation standards. Ability to review and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational guides, and daily checklists. Ability to work effectively following an accelerated onboarding process for each new assignment. Previous experience with medical offices is preferred. Systems Medical practices may use different software platforms, including: Athenahealth eClinicalWorks Nextech HealthArc EMA Other proprietary systems The position requires the ability to understand not only the software used by each practice, but also the operational processes and procedures established by that particular medical office. Assignment and Onboarding Model When coverage is required: A client reports an upcoming absence or unexpected staffing need. A floating assistant is assigned. The assistant receives an accelerated onboarding. The assistant reviews the client's documentation. The assistant begins providing temporary coverage until the assigned employee returns. Because medical offices may operate differently, each assignment may require adaptation to new workflows, provider preferences, software systems, and operational procedures. Comprehensive client documentation, structured onboarding, and ongoing support during the initial stages of each assignment are key components of the floating coverage model. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: About Homeaglow Homeaglow ’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services. We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication. Why Join Homeaglow ? Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles. Vertical Expansion Strategy Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships. Building a World-Class Team Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform. About the Role We are hiring a Director of Operations Technology & Automation, reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer, to own the automation, technology, and AI integration into our customer facing teams. This is a pivotal role to chart the automation and AI integration course of a rapidly scaling $100 million+ marketplace, focused on improving quality of our customer experience, while directly driving revenue and increasing efficiency within our 1,000+ customer-facing agent population. This role will own the roadmap on which automation and AI integration to prioritize, having autonomy to choose third parties, prioritize experiments, and leveraging our dedicated Operations engineers. Success is measured in incremental revenue, cost-to-serve, improved customer experience, and faster response and handle times — not in features shipped. What You’ll Own Roadmap & Prioritization Build and maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap for Operations tooling, automation, and AI features, prioritized by risk-adjusted ROI - working closely with our fast-paced engineering team (including dedicated Ops engineers), as well as the broader Operations Org, and Strategy team. Act as the owner for each initiative end-to-end — from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurement - within a rigorous fast-paced AB testing environment. AI Integration and Tooling Be the leader integrating AI into the company, including making the buy vs. build decisions, and managing relationships and pilots with key vendors. Leverage the relationships with Hubspot, Aircall, and smaller third parties to evaluate and integrate AI solutions - or decide to build in-house with our engineering team. Translate operational pain points and revenue opportunities into a prioritized backlog for tooling improvements with clear hypotheses and success metrics. Measurement & Operating Rhythm Weekly reporting on KPIs - which you will define based on specific project focus areas, e.g., sales automation might prioritize conversion rate on leads or touch to connect ratio, care AI integration would show costs saved / improved handling time / increased customer satisfaction. Maintain a tight feedback loop with frontline reps and managers
